pricingEvidence.evidence: Web search summary: "The Creator plan costs $60 per month and includes 25 minutes per month, while the Creator Pro plan is $150 per month for 100 minutes per month… The Business plan costs $750 per month and includes 500 minutes… lip-sync features cost 3 times the minutes"

nl.tagline: Video's vertalen en nasynchroniseren in meer dan honderd talen
nl.description: Rask AI vertaalt video's automatisch: transcriptie, vertaling, ingesproken stem (ook gekloond) en optioneel lipsync. Geschikt om bestaande content internationaal te hergebruiken.
bestFor: YouTube- en trainingsvideo's in meerdere talen
Teams die veel minuten video lokaliseren
notFor: Incidenteel gebruik met een klein budget
limitations: Lipsync verbruikt drie keer zoveel minuten

en.tagline: Translate and dub videos into more than a hundred languages
en.description: Rask AI translates videos automatically: transcription, translation, voice-over (including cloned voices) and optional lip sync. Suited to reusing existing content internationally.
bestFor: YouTube and training videos in multiple languages
notFor: Occasional use on a small budget
limitations: Lip sync consumes three times the minutes
